entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State where an EMM context has been established and a default EPS bearer context may be activated in the MME.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context
entities.description: Bearer context activated in MME under certain conditions in EMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection not supported
entities.description: Condition where UE or MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection.

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity
entities.description: Condition where UE has requested connectivity to a PDN and default EPS bearer is successfully established.

relations.description: EMM-REGISTERED state establishes an EMM context.
Condition of no PDN connection support establishes default EPS bearer context activation.
Condition of UE requesting PDN connectivity establishes default EPS bearer context.
EMM-REGISTERED state is guarded by condition of no PDN connection support.
EMM-REGISTERED state is guarded by condition of UE requesting PDN connectivity.
